newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Moody's confirms Okobank deposit ratings.
newsitem.headline: Moody's confirms Okobank deposit ratings.

text.p: Credit ratings agency Moody's on Thursday said it confirmed the A2/Prime-1 deposit ratings and D+ financial strength of Finland's Osuuspankkien Keskuspankki Oy, or Okobank.
Moody's said the rating action followed the recent announcement that the Okobank group will be restructured with effect from July 1 this year.
The agency said the restructuring would result in a group of 250 member banks becoming legally binded through a joint and several guarantee structure.
"This will enhance the existing organisation whereby all members pledge a percentage of assets to a security fund which may be used to support an ailing group member," the statement said.
Okobank, the central financial institution in the Finnish cooperative banks, is the third largest bank with total assets of 45.6 billion markka at year end 1996.
